selected_direction.research_question: Across a declared range of layer count, vacuum pressure, and quasi-static bending severity, for which measurable outputs and operating conditions does the Zhang et al. continuum layer-jamming beam model meet predeclared, justified error tolerances against a verified full-layer frictional-contact reference and independent experiments, and which contact or slip mechanisms explain failures?
selected_direction.scientific_hypothesis: M1's output-specific error will generally grow as finite-layer discreteness and slip or contact-pressure redistribution become important, yielding experimentally resolvable validity and breakdown regions. The predicted trend and boundary are testable and may be rejected.
